# Fathom

Unmodified upstream sources from https://github.com/jdart1/Fathom at
`c9c6fef0dddc05d2e242c183acf5833149ab676d` (2025-12-24).
The upstream MIT license is included in `LICENSE`.

MORS explicitly compiles `tbprobe.c` as **C++23** with `-x c++`.
The original filenames and contents are retained to simplify upstream updates.
`tbchess.c` is included by `tbprobe.c`; do not compile it separately.
No tablebase data files are bundled.
